Fruit Puffed Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 22, 2009 - 11:24pm

Ingredients




1 pkt One-step angel food cake mix
1/2 cup Water
1 cup Dried fruit
Such as raisins
Apricots
Dates
Or prunes
1/2 cup Chopped pecans optional

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine cake mix and water. Stir in fruit and nuts. Cover cookie sheet with foil. Drop cookies by rounded teaspoonfuls onto foil. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until cookies become puffed and golden. Let cool; remove from foil using a metal spatula. 2 Yield: 3dozen cookies.
